QuestInfo.name: Gift for a Fresh Fox
QuestInfo.0: The foxes prepared a gift for you to celebrate you passing the test. You should talk to #bSilver#k.
QuestInfo.1: The foxes prepared a gift for you to celebrate you passing the test. Head to #bShade's House#k to see what the present is.
QuestInfo.2: It turns out that the foxes prepared a pair of fox ears and a tail accessory to celebrate you being acknowledged as a fox.
